channel.title: Arati Uday Kamat - Publications
channel.description: Working papers, preprints and datasets by Arati Uday Kamat.

item.title: Hour-Aware Adaptive Risk Management for Autonomous Memecoin Trading on Solana DEXs: Evidence, Theory, and Design Lessons from a 15-Day Deployment
item.description: A 15-day paper-traded deployment of an autonomous memecoin trading system (190 trades). The hour-of-day pattern is directional and not confirmatory, and removing the top three trades makes the cumulative return unprofitable. The contribution is measurement infrastructure and three design lessons.

item.title: Post-Rejection Follow-up Sampling: Measuring Outcomes of Rejected Decisions in Algorithmic DEX Trading
item.description: A method for recording what rejected tokens do after a trading filter rejects them.

item.title: Outcome-Classified Precision Auditing of Filter Rules in Algorithmic DEX Trading: Evidence from 2,400 Rejection Events
item.description: Counts rejected events whose tracked price later halved (saves) or doubled (misses) within 24 hours; the save-to-miss ratio is descriptive.

item.title: OR1 operational-loss panel: banks' operational-risk losses from Basel Pillar 3 OR1 tables, 2016-2025
item.description: Dataset (CC BY 4.0). Operational-risk losses of 39 banks as printed in their Basel Pillar 3 OR1 tables, 2016-2025, with the source page and file fingerprint for every value.

item.title: RBI monetary penalties on banks, 2023-2026: a coded dataset
item.description: Dataset (CC BY 4.0). The monetary penalties on banks that the Reserve Bank of India announced by press release from 2 January 2023 to 8 October 2026: 890 records, of which 885 are bank penalties on 699 banks, each coded for the control area that failed and for how it failed.
